---
name: Feature request
about: Request new features or improvements
title: "[FEATURE REQUEST]"
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## Summary

Provide a clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you would like to see.

---

## Problem

Describe the problem or limitation that this feature would solve.

If this feature is related to an existing issue or inconvenience, explain it here.

---

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you would like this feature to work.

Include as much detail as possible.

---

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions, workarounds, or approaches you have considered.

If none, write "None."

---

## Use Case

Explain how this feature would benefit users or improve the project.

If applicable, describe a real-world scenario where this feature would be useful.

---

## Additional Information

Provide any additional context that may help explain your request.

Examples include:

- Mockups
- Screenshots
- Diagrams
- References
- Links to similar features in other projects

---

## Checklist

Before submitting, please confirm the following:

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this feature has not already been requested.
- [ ] I have clearly described the feature and its intended behavior.
- [ ] I have provided sufficient context to explain why this feature would be valuable.
